source_text: Sed si id per singula facere velim, et eadem repetendo superfluus et cuncta persequendo longus videbor.
pass_a_gloss: But if I should want to do that through each, I will seem both superfluous by repeating the same and long by pursuing all.

pass_b_english: But if I wanted to do that with every point, I would seem needless by repeating the same things and lengthy by pursuing them all.
